name: Tsundere Imouto wa Oshaburi Chuudoku
original_name: ツンデレ妹はおしゃぶり中毒
source: Yuuta's younger sister Makoto has two sides, tsuntsun and deredere. He likes her when she's deredere but hates her when she's tsuntsun. How will he get her to be deredere for him all the time?
translation: 佑太的妹妹真奈有两副面孔：一面冷淡别扭，一面黏人撒娇。他喜欢她撒娇时的样子，却讨厌她冷淡别扭时的样子。要怎样才能让她始终对自己撒娇呢？
